newDescription:
In this Year 5 English lesson, pupils revise key grammar, punctuation, vocabulary and spelling through a sequence of riddles and word puzzles.

This lesson includes:
✔ Solving grammar and punctuation riddles involving fronted adverbials, suffixes, homophones, clauses, apostrophes, imperative verbs and inverted commas
✔ Revising plural nouns, exclamation sentences, present tense, antonyms and nouns
✔ Reviewing commas, active and passive voice, and complex sentences
✔ Explaining the meaning and function of each grammar or punctuation term after solving each riddle
✔ Using nine-letter word grids to create as many smaller words as possible
✔ Finding hidden nine-letter words by rearranging all the letters in a grid
✔ Developing spelling, vocabulary and word-recognition skills through repeated word-building challenges
✔ Revising vocabulary through hidden words such as beginning, happiness, knowledge, consonant, beautiful and invisible
✔ Exploring further words including disappear, important, difficult, favourite, therefore, adjective and irregular
✔ Reinforcing correct British spellings such as favourite and necessary
✔ Revisiting proper nouns, word meanings and grammatical terminology through the hidden-word activities

Pupils begin with a series of fifteen riddles that revisit important grammar, punctuation and vocabulary concepts. Each answer is then explained, helping pupils recall both the term and how it is used in a sentence.

The riddles cover a broad range of Year 5 English knowledge, including clauses, punctuation, sentence types, tense, word classes, active and passive voice, and complex sentences.

The second half of the lesson moves into word puzzles. Pupils use sets of nine letters to build smaller words before finding a hidden nine-letter word. The activities develop spelling, vocabulary, pattern recognition and flexible word knowledge.

By the end of the lesson, pupils will have revised a wide range of grammar and punctuation terminology and strengthened their spelling and vocabulary through challenging word-building puzzles.
